note: Consumer.gov-specific provider-label resolution registry. Durable market facts such as reusable brands, trade names and product-to-risk-carrier relationships belong in data/reference/v2/verified_relationships.json and must be consumed from the canonical identity layer. This file is reserved for source-specific wrappers, truncated provider labels, ambiguous labels and explicit outside-universe classifications. Every mapping must be source-backed. Similarity or fuzzy matching may suggest candidates but never creates a resolution. A complaint record is evidence of consumer friction, not proof of abusive conduct or contractual wrongdoing. Sales channels, brokers, cooperatives and retailers must never have their complaints transferred to a carrier merely because they distribute that carrier's products.
